title: SPECMEM: Accelerating Agentic Tool Calling via Live Memory Management
abstract: arXiv:2610.31840v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tool-calling agents are mostly optimized for accuracy; in deployment, however, their growing cost is latency: every tool call is decoded autoregressively. Speculative decoding accelerates this without changing the output, and retrieved past calls make strong drafts under real use, where each user's behavior tends to repeat. Yet existing systems keep no cross-session memory, or build the draft store once and never update it. We propose SpecMem, a tool-call memory kept alive and managed throughout deployment: verified calls are written back online into bounded per-user stores with LRU eviction, and a side-effect gate defers irreversible calls until verification confirms. On multi-session, multi-user query streams served by three open-weight models, a frozen store steadily loses acceptance while SpecMem holds it: a 27% gap in mean accepted tokens (+11% to +34% across benchmarks, tracking how much novel work arrives after the store is built)

translated_title: SPECMEM：通过实时记忆管理加速智能体工具调用
translated_abstract: 工具调用智能体通常以准确性为主要优化目标；然而在部署阶段，其日益凸显的成本是延迟：每次工具调用都需要自回归地解码。投机解码可以在不改变输出结果的前提下加速这一过程，而在真实使用场景中，由于每个用户的行为往往具有重复性，检索过去的调用记录可以生成高质量的草稿。然而，现有系统要么不保留跨会话记忆，要么只在初始阶段构建一次草稿库且之后从不更新。我们提出 SpecMem，一种在整个部署过程中持续保持活跃并被管理的工具调用记忆：经过验证的调用会在线写回至带有 LRU 淘汰机制的、容量受限的每用户存储中，并且一个副作用门控机制会推迟不可逆调用的执行，直至验证确认后才进行。在由三个开源权重模型服务的多会话、多用户查询流上，冻结的草稿库的接受率会持续下降，而 SpecMem 则能保持接受率：平均接受 token 数相差 27%（各基准上为 +11% 至 +34%，具体取决于草稿库构建后出现的新任务量）。
tldr: SpecMem 提出一种在部署全过程中持续活跃管理的工具调用记忆机制，通过在线写回已验证调用（配合 LRU 淘汰）和副作用门控，使投机解码在多用户多会话场景下相比冻结草稿库保持约 27% 的平均接受 token 优势。
en_tdlr: SpecMem introduces a live, continuously managed tool-call memory—featuring online write-back of verified calls with LRU eviction and a side-effect gate—that sustains speculative decoding acceptance (+27% mean accepted tokens over frozen stores) in multi-session, multi-user deployments.
